item.title: Grass verge overgrowing into cycle path along Lansdown Road, 5th July
item.description:
I am raising a concern about the condition of the cycling path between the Triumph garage and the Rotunda roundabout along Lansdown Road in Cheltenham. Overgrown grass from the verges is currently encroaching onto the path, in places covering up to 75% of its width. This is forcing cyclists onto the adjacent pedestrian path, which creates a safety risk for both cyclists and pedestrians. I only became aware of quite how bad the problem had become when a telecommunications provider recently visited to install new equipment and had to clear a small area of overgrowth to carry out the work. Seeing the difference this small area of clearance made highlighted just how overgrown the rest of the path has become by comparison. As a regular user of this route, I believe it is important that the cycle path remains clear and usable as intended, both for safety and to avoid unnecessary conflict between cyclists and pedestrians sharing the footway. Please can you arrange for maintenance of the path to
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 54, Lansdown Road, Warden Hill, Cheltenham, Cheltenham
